FIELD NOTES / AUSTRALIAN SEASONS
BEFORE YOU ASK…

THE SMALL
PRINT.

Minus the tiny font.
Can I book a one-off tidy?＋

That’s the idea. Choose a one-off visit in the quote builder and describe what needs doing, from a simple mow to an overgrown garden reset.

What happens to the clippings?＋

Tell us if you have a green bin or prefer clippings to be mulched. Removal needs depend on the job and should be agreed as part of the final quote.

How does the quote builder work?＋

It creates an illustrative price range and a downloadable request based on your selections. This demo does not send your details or confirm a booking. A final quote needs a real assessment.

What if my garden needs a bit of everything?＋

Pick “Regular garden love” or select multiple services, then add a note about the work. The request builder gives you room for the whole picture.
